Naruto - Clash of Ninja.name: Naruto: Clash of Ninja
Naruto - Clash of Ninja.summary: Naruto Clash of Ninja is the first of the Naruto Clash of ninja games.It includes 8 playable characters (and 2 unlockables) from the Naruto anime.

Rune II - Koruten no Kagi no Himitsu.name: Lost Kingdoms II
Rune II - Koruten no Kagi no Himitsu.summary: Lost Kingdoms II is a card-themed RPG for the Gamecube. Set 200 years after Queen Katia saved her kingdom from the God of Destruction, Tara Grimface must now save the land from a new threat.
